One stop shop. Priceline is the best app to use if you’re booking just a hotel, car, flight, or even a combination. Very Horrible First Experience. I am requesting a full refund due to a serious issue with my reservation. When I arrived at the property, there was no staff available to check me in or show me to my room. I waited approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes, and no one ever arrived. During that time, I repeatedly called the property’s phone number, but no one answered. The following day, I contacted the property again and explained the situation. The representative advised me to contact Priceline directly regarding a refund. I then called the customer service number provided to me. After entering my trip information and requesting to speak with a live representative, I was placed on hold. After approximately two minutes, the call was redirected to a survey asking me to rate the assistance I received, despite never speaking with an agent, and then the call disconnected. This experience has been extremely frustrating. I paid for accommodations that I was unable to access because there was no staff available to check me in and no way to obtain assistance. As a result, I am requesting a full refund. This was my first time using Priceline for a hotel booking, and I am very disappointed with how this situation was handled. I would appreciate a prompt resolution and confirmation of my refund request. I’ve been trying so hard to keep my cool and be respectful.

They just want your money!. We checked in at a hotel that we booked through Priceline at 10:00 PM. Shortly after arriving, we discovered that the shower knob was broken and the shower could not be used.

We immediately contacted the front desk. The supervisor initially stated that there was no technician on-site and that the issue would have to wait until the morning. She also said there were no available rooms and refused to move us. After we insisted, she said she would contact a technician to come fix the issue.

It is now 7:00 AM, and no one has arrived. Each time we contact the front desk, we are told to continue waiting. We were also told that the front desk does not have the technician’s phone number. During our most recent call, the staff member hung up on us.

At this point, it is clear that we were misled. We were told someone would come, but no one has. Had we been given honest information, we could have made other arrangements or gone to sleep earlier instead of staying awake after a long day of travel.

We are here for a wedding and must get ready and leave by 6:00 AM. Not having access to a working shower is unacceptable. The way this situation has been handled is deeply unprofessional, frustrating, and unacceptable.
